authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 202-186 and the Ten Katestraat corner (even side, 1897-1917), 2024-12-11 overcast strip. A white-banded kinker-1890-brick-arched row: 202-200 with white pediment dormers, 192-198 as four modules (3+3 axes under one brick roof box, 2+2 axes under brick dormer towers), 188 (1917) with two dormers, 186 with a curved gable the type cannot say; the corner pand 073962 (olive brick, steep street gable) on kinker-1890-plain-brick.
